title: Anthropic valued at over $1 trillion in historic IPO
source: Axios — Anthropic valued at over $1 trillion in historic IPO (2026-11-18)
body: Anthropic on Wednesday raised over $81 billion in a long-awaited IPO that valued the Claude maker at over $1 trillion. Why it matters: Wall Street expects the AI boom to continue, despite some recent tumult. Zoom in: Anthropic priced at $83 per share, well above its planned range of $70 to $78 per share. It imputes an initial market cap of $1.08 trillion and a fully diluted value of around $1.5 trillion. Anthropic originally planned to sell 825 million shares, but increased it to 980 million shares. The company also could raise significantly more money if underwriters exercise their so-called "greenshoe" option, while Anthropic also will receive $26 billion via a concurrent private placement from tech giants like Nvidia, Google and Microsoft. Allocation decisions were expected to last several hours on Wednesday evening. Context: Anthropic was valued at $965 billion in its most recent private round. The apples-to-apples comparison would be with the fully diluted value. SpaceX is the current IPO record-holder having raised $86.25 billion, although that included the greenshoe. What we're watching: Shares are expected to begin trading Thursday, Nov. 19, on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT."
